incidents_closure_invariant_chk.name: incidents_closure_invariant_chk
incidents_closure_invariant_chk.value: "incidents"."status" <> 'CLOSED' OR "incidents"."accepted_qty" >= "incidents"."required_qty" OR ("incidents"."waiver_approval_id" IS NOT NULL AND "incidents"."schedule_disposition" IS NOT NULL)

incidents_open_invariant_chk.name: incidents_open_invariant_chk
incidents_open_invariant_chk.value: "incidents"."status" = 'CLOSED' OR ("incidents"."owner" IS NOT NULL AND "incidents"."next_review_at" IS NOT NULL AND ("incidents"."next_action" IS NOT NULL OR "incidents"."blocker" IS NOT NULL))
